summary: Rayonier Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Ryan M. Daniels as permanent Senior Vice President, Wood Products, having served as interim since March 2026 after a prior merger with PotlatchDeltic. This is a routine executive appointment, not a forced or abrupt departure. There are no stated deal terms, premiums, or advisors. The filing includes no structural mechanics or regulatory clocks. This appears to be a standard compensatory arrangement update, not a special-situation event. The designation as Management Changes is conservative due to the permanent appointment following an interim role, but confidence is low as it lacks abrupt departure context.
